blocks.text: Information security and change management policy
HANGS Construction Services LLC
Status: approved by the board of directors on June 12, 2023; owner Jordan Hale, Chief Financial Officer
1. Systems in scope
System: Ledgerwyn; Ledgerwyn Desktop Accounting 7.4; General ledger, job cost, billing, cash receipts and the close; owner Dana Whitfield
System: Vellumrow; Vellumrow Invoice Desk 2.3; Vendor invoices and approvals, the vendor master and payment releases to the Cinderbrook Bank portal; owner Dana Whitfield
System: Charterfold; Charterfold Payroll 1.6; The employee master, pay rates, timecards, payroll processing and release; owner Renata Salazar
System: Quillpost; Quillpost Mail and Directory; Email and the sign-in directory for Vellumrow; payment and pay-change approvals arrive by email; owner Mateo Grummond
2. Access
2.1 Passwords: at least 12 characters, with complexity; an account locks after 5 failed sign-ins.
2.2 Multi-factor sign-in is required for every account that can reach financial data or email.
2.3 Leavers: the system owner disables every account of a leaver within 1 business day of the last day.
2.4 Access review: each system owner reviews every user’s rights every year and the CFO signs the review.
2.5 No shared or generic accounts. A vendor account is enabled only for a ticketed change and disabled when the change is done.
2.6 Administrator rights are held apart from rights to enter transactions.
Conflict: Vendor master: add and edit / Bank portal: approve payments
Conflict: Bank portal: create payments / Bank portal: approve payments
Conflict: Payroll master: edit / Payroll: process
Conflict: Journal entries: post / Journal entries: approve
3. Changes
3.1 A change to a financial system or its settings needs a ticket, a test and the CFO’s approval before it goes live.
3.2 Manual journal entries over $25,000.00 are approved by a second person before posting; each period is locked when it closes.
Demonstration document. Every name and figure is invented.
